EU approves Deutsche Boerse's €5.3 billion Allfunds deal

The deal for Allfunds Group is the largest acquisition in the German exchange operator's history. Deutsche Boerse AG's €5.3 billion bid for Allfunds Group Plc is worth $5.8 billion. The European Union's approval carries no conditions.

Reported by Bloomberg.
